adjudication.rationale: In spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb, the “valid host” examples stub `retrieved_recently?` (`topic_retriever.expects(:retrieved_recently?).returns(false/true)`) and assert on `perform_retrieve` being called/not called (`topic_retriever.expects(:perform_retrieve).once/never`). This means the actual throttle logic in `retrieved_recently?` (Redis `setnx`/`expire`, `no_throttle` early return) and the real retrieval behavior inside `perform_retrieve` (TopicEmbed `exists?` bail-out, RSS-first branch calling `Jobs::PollFeed`, and `fetch_http`’s `embed_by_username` user lookup/blank-user return) are not exercised by these tests.
